name: A Claude project
who: A small business with no technical team
steps: Create a Claude project for one role.
Copy the agent instruction from the catalog site into the project instructions.
Add a COMPANY.md file describing the business to the project knowledge.
Give the first real task and check the answer.
limit: One role per project; handing tasks between agents is manual.

name: Skills in claude.ai
who: Someone who needs procedures without roles
need: Claude with Skills and code execution turned on
steps: Take the folder you need from plugin/skills.
Zip it so that the skill folder itself is inside.
Upload it under Customize, Skills.
Check on a task that the skill turns on by itself.
limit: Skills without agents; the calculation skill needs code execution.

name: Claude Code plugin
who: A team working with Claude Code
steps: /plugin marketplace add ASAN-7770104/ai-crew
/plugin install ai-crew@ai-crew
/ai-crew:company-setup
Start with three roles and the shared board company/board.md.
limit: You need to be comfortable with a terminal or the Code tab.

name: Claude Cowork
who: Staff who work with documents and mail
steps: Zip the plugin folder.
Upload the plugin in the Cowork settings.
Connect calendar and drive, read only at first.
Run the company setup.
limit: Settings move around: check the current Claude help.

name: The whole organization
who: A company on a team plan
steps: Choose the roles and a person responsible for each.
Share the skills through the organization's plugin and skill settings.
Write down which actions need approval.
Train people on real tasks.
limit: Depends on your plan and your organization's rules.

name: Schedules and automations
steps: Run the day summary by hand for a week first.
Schedule reading and drafts only.
Add a notification to the responsible person.
Leave every outgoing send to a person.

name: Inside your own product
who: An IT team embedding agents into a service
need: A developer, an API key, the Claude Agent SDK
steps: Take the roles from data/roles.en.json.
Build agents on the Claude Agent SDK with limited tools.
Enforce human approval in code.
Add an action log and spending limits.
limit: Usage-based billing; needs maintenance and security.

name: Done-for-you service
need: A named responsible person on the client side
steps: Study the business and choose three roles.
Set up, connect and agree approval rules.
Two weeks of supervised work.
Hand over against the acceptance criteria and support monthly.
limit: Fix scope, price and responsibility in a contract.
